title: How to open an Advertising business in Portugal | Rauva

facts.fact: The page states that Portugal saw an estimated 1,200 new advertising companies enter the market in 2023, as reported by the National Institute of Statistics (INE).
facts.quote: with an estimated 1,200 new companies entering the market, as reported by the National Institute of Statistics (INE)

facts.fact: The page cites PwC's Global Entertainment and Media Outlook as projecting the Portuguese advertising market to grow at a CAGR of 5.1% from 2023 to 2027.
facts.quote: the Portuguese advertising market is projected to grow at a CAGR of 5.1% from 2023 to 2027

facts.fact: The page cites PwC's Global Entertainment and Media Outlook as projecting the Portuguese advertising market to reach approximately 1.5 billion euros by the end of the 2023-2027 forecast period.
facts.quote: reaching approximately 1.5 billion euros by the end of this forecast period

facts.fact: The page states that digital advertising accounts for over 60% of total advertising spending in Portugal.
facts.quote: digital advertising, which accounts for over 60% of total advertising spending in the country

facts.fact: The page states that Rauva's business account allows making and receiving payments in over 40 currencies.
facts.quote: a business account for making and receiving payments in over 40 currencies

facts.fact: The page states that after company registration in Portugal, a business account and certified accounting must be set up within 15 days.
facts.quote: Within 15 days of your company’s registration, you need to establish a business account for your transactions and set up certified accounting.
